# IMPERIA COLD WAR — OPEC 1970 (window state; lists are built for open windows and clicks only).
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_OPEC_generator/build.py (do not edit by hand).

# Country scope (player). Opens the OPEC window.
COLDWAR_OPEC_open_window = {
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_open
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_viewers value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_viewers = THIS }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab < 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_chap = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_item = 11 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_route = 2 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_o1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_o2 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_chain = 2 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tfilt = 0 }
	}
	# saves from before the graph was computed monthly
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_hf1 < 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_hist_frames = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_refresh = yes
}

# Country scope (player). Opens the window at the resolution cwop_x_open (the three Cold War ballots and the UAE decision point here).
COLDWAR_OPEC_open_at = {
	# a Cold War decision points to its resolution in the RESOLUTIONS tab (the defaults first when the window was never open)
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab < 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_chap = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_item = 11 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_route = 2 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_o1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_o2 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_chain = 2 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tfilt = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 4 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_item = cwop_x_open }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_open < 20 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_chap = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_open < 30 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_chap = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_chap = 3 }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_open_window = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

		set_variable = { cwop_ui_f_left = cwop_ui_f_due }

		clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_f_left min = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 9 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_f_rule = 6 }
		}

			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_route = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_f_rule = 5 }

		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_props = yes
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_f_rule = cwop_t_thr }
		}
		clear_array = cwop_ui_dall
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 9 } }
			for_each_loop = { array = global.cwop_cands value = cwop_t_c add_to_array = { cwop_ui_dall = cwop_t_c } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 6 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_target > 0 } }
				add_to_array = { cwop_ui_dall = cwop_ui_f_target }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_route = 1 } }

		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = { limit = { is_ai = no } add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_dall = THIS } }
				}
			}
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_dall = THIS } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_ndel = cwop_ui_dall^num }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = cwop_ui_ndel }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = 7 }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = 8 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = 0.499 }
		round_temp_variable = cwop_t_r
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_r min = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_dpages = cwop_t_r }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_dpage < cwop_ui_dpages } } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_dpage = cwop_ui_dpages }
			add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_dpage = -1 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_dpage min = 0 }
		clear_array = cwop_ui_dpg
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_lo = cwop_ui_dpage }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_lo = 8 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_hi = cwop_t_lo }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_hi = 8 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = cwop_ui_dall
			value = cwop_t_val
			index = cwop_t_idx
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_t_idx < cwop_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwop_t_idx < cwop_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwop_ui_dpg = cwop_t_val } }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_dpage1 = cwop_ui_dpage }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_dpage1 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_d1 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_dpg^num > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_d1 = cwop_ui_dpg^0 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_d2 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_dpg^num > 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_d2 = cwop_ui_dpg^1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_d3 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_dpg^num > 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_d3 = cwop_ui_dpg^2 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_d4 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_dpg^num > 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_d4 = cwop_ui_dpg^3 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_d5 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_dpg^num > 4 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_d5 = cwop_ui_dpg^4 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_d6 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_dpg^num > 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_d6 = cwop_ui_dpg^5 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_d7 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_dpg^num > 6 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_d7 = cwop_ui_dpg^6 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_d8 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_dpg^num > 7 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_d8 = cwop_ui_dpg^7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_del = 0 }
				check_variable = { cwop_ui_d1 > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_del = cwop_ui_d1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_d1 > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_h = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 10 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_sgvi = global.cwop_s9_issue }
						check_variable = { cwop_sgv = cwop_ui_d1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 11 }
				}
				# AI delegations that prefer this candidate
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_dv1 = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = cwop_ui_d1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_mine = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = cwop_ui_d1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_mine = 2 }

							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 2 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 3 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 4 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 2 }
						var:cwop_ui_d8 = { check_variable = { cwop_vi2 = global.cwop_s2_issue } } }
					var:cwop_ui_d8 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pv = cwop_v2 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 3 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 9 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 2 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 2 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 3 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 4 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 3 }
						var:cwop_ui_d8 = { check_variable = { cwop_vi3 = global.cwop_s3_issue } } }
					var:cwop_ui_d8 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pv = cwop_v3 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 3 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 9 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 2 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 2 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 3 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 4 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 4 }
						var:cwop_ui_d8 = { check_variable = { cwop_vi4 = global.cwop_s4_issue } } }
					var:cwop_ui_d8 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pv = cwop_v4 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 3 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 9 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 2 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 2 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 3 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 4 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 5 }
						var:cwop_ui_d8 = { check_variable = { cwop_vi5 = global.cwop_s5_issue } } }
					var:cwop_ui_d8 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pv = cwop_v5 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 3 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 9 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 2 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 2 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 3 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 4 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 6 }
						var:cwop_ui_d8 = { check_variable = { cwop_vi6 = global.cwop_s6_issue } } }
					var:cwop_ui_d8 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pv = cwop_v6 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 3 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 9 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 2 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 2 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 3 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 4 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 7 }
						var:cwop_ui_d8 = { check_variable = { cwop_vi7 = global.cwop_s7_issue } } }
					var:cwop_ui_d8 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pv = cwop_v7 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 3 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 9 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 2 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 2 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 3 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 4 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel = 8 }
						var:cwop_ui_d8 = { check_variable = { cwop_vi8 = global.cwop_s8_issue } } }
					var:cwop_ui_d8 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pv = cwop_v8 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 3 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 9 }
						}
					}
					else = {

							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 1 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 2 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_pv = 2 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 3 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 4 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase < 3 }
						check_variable = { cwop_t_st = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_st = 12 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ds8 = cwop_t_st }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_dh8 = cwop_t_h }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_dm8 = cwop_t_h }
			add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_dm8 = 100 }
			divide_variable = { cwop_ui_dm8 = 10 }
			round_variable = cwop_ui_dm8
			add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_dm8 = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_dm8 min = 1 max = 21 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_del = cwop_ui_d8 } }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_dsel8 = 2 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_dsel8 = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel < 9 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pf = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pr = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pa = 0 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = cwop_ui_dall
				if = { limit = { exists = yes }
					COLDWAR_OPEC_vote_of = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 2 } }
						add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pa = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 3 } }
						add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pr = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
					}
					else = {
						add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pf = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_pf = cwop_t_pf }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_pf = 100 }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_pr = cwop_t_pr }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_pr = 100 }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_pa = cwop_t_pa }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_pa = 100 }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_po = 100 }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_po = cwop_ui_pf }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_po = cwop_ui_pr }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_po = cwop_ui_pa }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_po min = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_bf = cwop_ui_pf }
			divide_variable = { cwop_ui_bf = 5 }
			round_variable = cwop_ui_bf
			add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_bf = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_bf min = 1 max = 21 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = cwop_ui_pf }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = cwop_ui_pr }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_br = cwop_t_x }
			divide_variable = { cwop_ui_br = 5 }
			round_variable = cwop_ui_br
			add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_br = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_br min = 1 max = 21 }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ba = cwop_ui_pa }
			divide_variable = { cwop_ui_ba = 5 }
			round_variable = cwop_ui_ba
			add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_ba = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_ba min = 1 max = 21 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 3 } }
				COLDWAR_OPEC_tally_approval = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_ok = 1 } }
					set_variable = { cwop_ui_res = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { cwop_ui_res = 4 }
				}
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_nf = cwop_t_yes }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_na = cwop_t_no }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_n = cwop_t_n }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_nr = 0 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 6 } }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_res = 5 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_target > 0 } }
					var:cwop_ui_f_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_offer_stance = yes set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_h = cwop_h } }
					set_variable = { cwop_ui_offer_h = cwop_t_h }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 1 } check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 2 } check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 4 } check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 7 } } }
				COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_props = yes
				COLDWAR_OPEC_tally = yes
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_res = cwop_t_res }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_nf = cwop_t_nf }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_na = cwop_t_na }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_nr = cwop_t_nr }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_n = cwop_t_n }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_fsh = cwop_t_fshare }
				multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_fsh = 100 }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_nfd = cwop_t_nfound }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_ffd = cwop_t_ffound }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_res = 1 }
			}
		}
		# the selected delegation (for the reasons), computed last so its parts belong to this file
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_sel < 9 }
				check_variable = { cwop_ui_del > 0 }
				var:cwop_ui_del = { exists = yes is_ai = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_f_phase = 6 } }
				var:cwop_ui_del = { COLDWAR_OPEC_offer_stance = yes }
			}
			else = {
				var:cwop_ui_del = { COLDWAR_OPEC_stance = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope (viewer). The MEMBERS tab: members with status and obligations, producers outside OPEC with their answer to an invitation, the selected country.
COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_members = {
	clear_array = cwop_ui_mall
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_mall = THIS } }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_mall = THIS } }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.cwop_watch if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes } OR = { check_variable = { cwop_status > 0 } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_cooperating } } add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_mall = THIS } } }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_nm = cwop_ui_mall^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = cwop_ui_nm }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = 13 }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = 14 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwop_t_r
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_r min = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_mpages = cwop_t_r }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpage < cwop_ui_mpages } } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_mpage = cwop_ui_mpages }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_mpage = -1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_mpage min = 0 }
	clear_array = cwop_ui_mpg
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_lo = cwop_ui_mpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_lo = 14 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_hi = cwop_t_lo }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_hi = 14 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cwop_ui_mall
		value = cwop_t_val
		index = cwop_t_idx
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_t_idx < cwop_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwop_t_idx < cwop_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwop_ui_mpg = cwop_t_val } }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_mpage1 = cwop_ui_mpage }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_mpage1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m1 = cwop_ui_mpg^0 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m2 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m2 = cwop_ui_mpg^1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m3 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 2 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m3 = cwop_ui_mpg^2 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m4 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 3 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m4 = cwop_ui_mpg^3 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m5 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 4 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m5 = cwop_ui_mpg^4 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m6 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 5 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m6 = cwop_ui_mpg^5 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m7 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 6 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m7 = cwop_ui_mpg^6 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m8 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 7 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m8 = cwop_ui_mpg^7 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m9 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 8 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m9 = cwop_ui_mpg^8 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m10 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 9 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m10 = cwop_ui_mpg^9 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m11 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 10 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m11 = cwop_ui_mpg^10 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m12 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 11 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m12 = cwop_ui_mpg^11 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m13 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 12 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m13 = cwop_ui_mpg^12 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_m14 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_mpg^num > 13 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_m14 = cwop_ui_mpg^13 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_msel = cwop_ui_m1 }
			check_variable = { cwop_ui_m1 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_msf1 = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_msf1 = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_msel = cwop_ui_m2 }
			check_variable = { cwop_ui_m2 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_msf2 = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_msf2 = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_msel = cwop_ui_m3 }
			check_variable = { cwop_ui_m3 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_msf3 = 2 }

	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_msf14 = 1 }
	}
	clear_array = cwop_ui_xall
	for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.major_oil_exporters if = { limit = { exists = yes check_variable = { cwop_status < 2 } } add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_xall = THIS } } }
	for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.minor_oil_exporters if = { limit = { exists = yes check_variable = { cwop_status < 2 } } add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_xall = THIS } } }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_nx = cwop_ui_xall^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = cwop_ui_nx }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = 5 }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = 6 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwop_t_r = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwop_t_r
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_r min = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_xpages = cwop_t_r }

	clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_xpage min = 0 }

	multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_lo = 6 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_hi = cwop_t_lo }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_hi = 6 }

		array = cwop_ui_xall
		value = cwop_t_val
		index = cwop_t_idx
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_t_idx < cwop_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwop_t_idx < cwop_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwop_ui_xpg = cwop_t_val } }

	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 41 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_by = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_x1 > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_x1 = { COLDWAR_OPEC_offer_stance = yes set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_h = cwop_h } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_xv1 = cwop_t_h }

			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_msel = cwop_ui_x1 } }

	}
	# the selected country: quota discipline or the answer to an invitation (computed last, so its parts belong to it)
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_qh = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_iv = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_msel > 0 }
			var:cwop_ui_msel = { exists = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:cwop_ui_msel = { is_ai = yes is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_quota value = THIS } } }
			var:cwop_ui_msel = { COLDWAR_OPEC_quota_stance = yes set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_h = cwop_h } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_qh = cwop_t_h }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:cwop_ui_msel = { check_variable = { cwop_status < 2 } } }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 41 }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_by = THIS.id }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 0 }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = 0 }
			var:cwop_ui_msel = { COLDWAR_OPEC_offer_stance = yes set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_h = cwop_h } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_iv = cwop_t_h }
		}
	}
}

				every_country = { limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_net_exporter = yes OR = { check_variable = { cwop_status < 2 } COLDWAR_OPEC_is_associate = yes } NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes } OR = { check_variable = { PREV.cwop_ui_tfilt = 0 } AND = { check_variable = { PREV.cwop_ui_tfilt = 1 } COLDWAR_OPEC_is_west = yes } AND = { check_variable = { PREV.cwop_ui_tfilt = 2 } COLDWAR_OPEC_is_east = yes } AND = { check_variable = { PREV.cwop_ui_tfilt = 3 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } } } } add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_tall = THIS } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_item = 42 } }
				every_country = { limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_oil_producer = yes check_variable = { cwop_status < 2 } OR = { check_variable = { PREV.cwop_ui_tfilt = 0 } AND = { check_variable = { PREV.cwop_ui_tfilt = 1 } COLDWAR_OPEC_is_west = yes } AND = { check_variable = { PREV.cwop_ui_tfilt = 2 } COLDWAR_OPEC_is_east = yes } AND = { check_variable = { PREV.cwop_ui_tfilt = 3 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } } } } add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_tall = THIS } }
			}

		}
		else_if = {

			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ist = 6 }

# Country scope (viewer). The EMBARGOES & FUND tab: joint embargoes in compact rows, the classification lists, the Fund programmes, the national measures picker.
COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_emb = {
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ek1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekt1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekp1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekd1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eku1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekr1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekn1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eks1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eky1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ek2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekt2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekp2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekd2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eku2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekr2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekn2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eks2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eky2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ek3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekt3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekp3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekd3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eku3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekr3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekn3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eks3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eky3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ek4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekt4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekp4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekd4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eku4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekr4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekn4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eks4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_eky4 = 0 }
	clear_array = cwop_ui_eksrc1
	clear_array = cwop_ui_eksrc2
	clear_array = cwop_ui_eksrc3
	clear_array = cwop_ui_eksrc4
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwop_e1_target = { exists = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ek1 = 1 }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekt1 = global.cwop_e1_target }
			var:global.cwop_e1_target = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_p = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekp1 = cwop_t_p }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_ekp1 = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end > 0 } }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_eku1 = 1 }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekd1 = global.cwop_e1_end }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_ekd1 = global.num_days }
				clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_ekd1 min = 0 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_peace = 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_eku1 = 2 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_eku1 = 3 }
			}
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekr1 = global.cwop_e1_route }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekn1 = global.cwop_e1_tg^num }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_eky1 = global.cwop_e1_since }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_eky1 = global.cwop_epoch }
			divide_variable = { cwop_ui_eky1 = 365 }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_eky1 = 0.499 }
			round_variable = cwop_ui_eky1
			add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_eky1 = 1970 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_s = 0 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_e1_src
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_s = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share } add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_eksrc1 = THIS } }
			}
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_eks1 = cwop_t_s }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_eks1 = 100 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k = 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ek2 = 1 }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekt2 = global.cwop_e1_target }
			var:global.cwop_e1_target = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_p = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekp2 = cwop_t_p }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_ekp2 = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end > 0 } }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_eku2 = 1 }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekd2 = global.cwop_e1_end }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_ekd2 = global.num_days }
				clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_ekd2 min = 0 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_peace = 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_eku2 = 2 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwop_ui_eku2 = 3 }
			}
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekr2 = global.cwop_e1_route }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_ekn2 = global.cwop_e1_tg^num }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_eky2 = global.cwop_e1_since }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_eky2 = global.cwop_epoch }

			}

				add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_cl2 = THIS }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwop_class = 4 } is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e1_tg value = THIS } is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e2_tg value = THIS } is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e3_tg value = THIS } is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e4_tg value = THIS } } }
				add_to_array = { PREV.cwop_ui_cl4 = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
	# targets of joint embargoes that are not watched (subjects, allies)

	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {

	else = {

		set_variable = { cwop_ui_np8 = cwop_ui_nppg^7 }
	}

		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_ntgt > 0 }
			NOT = { var:cwop_ui_ntgt = { exists = yes } } }

			set_variable = { cwop_ui_nst = 2 }
		}
	}
}

		var:cwop_ui_msel = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = cwop_ic_opin } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_ic_opin = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_ic_price = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_msel > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_msel = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = cwop_ic_price } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_ic_price = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_ic_quota = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_msel > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_msel = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = cwop_ic_quota } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_ic_quota = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_ic_temp = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_msel > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_msel = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = cwop_ic_temp } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_ic_temp = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_ic_war = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_msel > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_msel = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = cwop_ic_war } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_ic_war = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_per = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_msel > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_msel = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = cwop_per } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_msel_per = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_x1_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_x1 > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_x1 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_x1_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_x2_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_x2 > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_x2 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_x2_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_x3_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_x3 > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_x3 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_x3_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_x4_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_x4 > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_x4 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_x4_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_x5_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_x5 > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_x5 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_x5_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = cwop_t_uv }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_uv_x6_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_x6 > 0 } }
		var:cwop_ui_x6 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_uv = mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct } }
		set_variable = { cwop_uv_x6_mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = cwop_t_uv }
	}
}

# Country scope (a player with the window open). Rebuilds the values of the open tab for this player.
COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab < 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf5 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf1 = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 2 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf2 = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 3 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf3 = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 4 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf4 = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 5 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf5 = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_year = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_year = global.cwop_epoch }
	divide_variable = { cwop_ui_year = 365 }
	subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_year = 0.499 }
	round_variable = cwop_ui_year
	add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_year = 1970 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_sg_year = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sg > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_sg_year = global.cwop_sg_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_sg_year = global.cwop_epoch }
		divide_variable = { cwop_ui_sg_year = 365 }
		subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_sg_year = 0.499 }
		round_variable = cwop_ui_sg_year
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_sg_year = 1970 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_sess_left = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_in_session = yes }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_sess_left = global.cwop_sess_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_sess_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = cwop_ui_sess_left min = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_next_year = global.cwop_sess_next }
	subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_next_year = global.cwop_epoch }
	divide_variable = { cwop_ui_next_year = 365 }
	subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_next_year = 0.499 }
	round_variable = cwop_ui_next_year
	add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_next_year = 1970 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_d = global.cwop_sess_next }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwop_t_d = global.cwop_epoch }
	modulo_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_d value = 365 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_d > 300 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_next_dec = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_next_dec = 0 }
	}
	# the open file count is needed by the RESOLUTIONS tab too
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_ui_nopen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_mkf1 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_mkf2 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_mkf3 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_mkf4 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_mkf5 = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_chain = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_mkf1 = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_chain = 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_mkf2 = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_chain = 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_mkf3 = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_chain = 4 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_mkf4 = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_chain = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_mkf5 = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_bal = resource_produced@oil }
		subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_bal = resource_consumed@oil }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_exs = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_exs = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_exs = 100 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tier = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_tier = mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_embn = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_sources^num }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_embp = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_embp = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_embp = 100 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_or = modifier@imp_oil_price_resistance }
		multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_or = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 2 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_conf = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_members = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_res = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 5 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_bal = resource_produced@oil }
		subtract_from_variable = { cwop_ui_bal = resource_consumed@oil }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_exs = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_exs = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_exs = 100 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tier = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_tier = mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_embn = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_sources^num }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_embp = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure }
			set_variable = { cwop_ui_embp = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_embp = 100 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_or = modifier@imp_oil_price_resistance }
		multiply_variable = { cwop_ui_or = 100 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_emb = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_values = yes
	# RECORD tab (sixth tab)
	set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf6 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ui_tab = 6 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ui_tabf6 = 2 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_record = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Something changed: refresh the open windows only (weekly, monthly and after national measures).
COLDWAR_OPEC_touch = {
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
	clear_temp_array = cwop_t_closed
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_viewers
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes
				is_ai = no
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_open }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_ui_refresh = yes
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_array = { cwop_t_closed = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwop_t_closed
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_viewers = THIS }
	}
}
